description: This file contains unit tests for the paragraph rendering features of the MigraDoc library, including text formatting, alignment, borders, tab stops, and document fields.

classes.name: TestParagraphRenderer
classes.description: Unit test class for various paragraph rendering functionalities in the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: TextAndBlanks
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with alternating text and blank characters, then renders and saves the PDF.

methods.name: Formatted
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with formatted text with different styles and saves the rendered PDF.

methods.name: FillFormattedParagraph
methods.description: Helper method to fill a paragraph with formatted text, applying bold and italic styles based on position.

methods.name: Alignment
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with specific alignment and indentation settings, then renders and saves PDF.

methods.name: Tabs
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with tab stops and text, then renders and saves PDF.

methods.name: GiveBorders
methods.description: Sets border styles and shading for a paragraph.

methods.name: Borders
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with formatted text and borders, then saves the document.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with various document fields (section, page, date, bookmarks) and saves the document.
